datePolicy: Local date in Pacific/Auckland, Asia/Seoul or Asia/Tokyo. RAW timestamps with destination offsets were normalized to the Panasonic camera clock at +08:00, verified with paired RAW/JPEG captures; adjustments are recorded per photo.
deduplication: Same filename stem: one JPEG/HEIC preferred to RAW; visually remove near-duplicates and screenshots.
mapPolicy: GPS-backed place groups; unlocated camera photos use visually reviewed landmarks and nearby capture time. Displayed points are place centers, not individual photo coordinates.
editorialPolicy: The 12 photo chapters, 25 daily entries and 28 place introductions are written from the curated photographs and existing captions. Personal note fields remain user-authored. Each daily cover is a photograph taken on that local date.

displayCorrections.evidence: IMG_7048.JPG and IMG_7049.JPG coordinates are around 34.43023 N, 135.238625 E at Kansai Airport; the adjacent IMG_7042.JPG is a visually reviewed arrival flight photo.
displayCorrections.implementation: src/atlas.ts applies the display correction while src/data/atlas.json keeps the original curated snapshot.
